items.title: Aon (AON) Q2 2026 Earnings Call Transcript
items.summary: Organic revenue grew 5% while margins expanded to 28.9% on new business strength.

items.title: AIG Beats Q2 Earnings Estimates on Robust Underwriting Income
items.summary: American International beats Q2 earnings estimates as stronger underwriting and lower catastrophe losses offset weaker investment income.

items.title: MetLife Tops Q2 Earnings Estimates on Strong Investment Income
items.summary: MET tops Q2 EPS estimates as higher investment income, favorable underwriting and business volume growth lift earnings despite higher expenses.

items.title: CNO Financial Beats Q2 Earnings Estimates on Higher Collected Premiums
items.summary: CNO posts a Q2 earnings beat as higher collected premiums and net investment income lift results, prompting the company to raise its 2026 EPS outlook.

items.title: VIRT Beats Q2 Earnings Estimates on Strong Market Making Performance
items.summary: VIRT beats Q2 earnings estimates as Market Making strength and higher commissions help lift adjusted net trading income despite rising expenses.

items.title: MKTX Q2 Earnings Beat Estimates on Strong Emerging Markets Volumes
items.summary: MarketAxess beats Q2 EPS estimates as strong emerging markets and Eurobonds trading volumes offset weaker commission revenues and softer core trading activity.

items.title: LNC Q2 Earnings Beat Estimates on Higher Investment Gains, Lower Costs
items.summary: Lincoln beats second-quarter earnings estimates as higher investment income, lower expenses and stronger segment profitability help offset softer sales in key businesses.

items.title: Goldman Sachs Adds Financial Giant to the August Conviction List of Top Stock Picks
items.summary: Goldman Sachs just refreshed its August Conviction List with a financial services name analysts say the market is sleeping on, and two other picks in the sector that could quietly outperform through year-end.
